prompts.prompt:
Art for a 2D top-down fantasy role-playing game. Bright, colorful medieval fantasy in clear daylight. Realistic proportions, nothing cartoonish, nothing grim. No text, no borders, no watermarks, no drop shadows.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape sprite sheet with directly front-facing complete painted heads of the exact same adult man in this game's paper-doll illustration. There are four columns and three rows, exactly twelve distinct complete heads. Reference 1 specifies exact identity, shape, ear width, nose, eye spacing, jaw, warm olive skin and the game camera. Reference 2 is a disposable alignment guide for the centers of the 4×3 grid and the face size. Reference 3 is a style and transparency example only. Match reference 1 identity faithfully. Keep eye line, head size, age, complexion, neutral expression, head angle, nose, mouth and ears the same across all twelve. No shoulders or clothing. Painterly realistic brushwork and daylight from upper left; medium brown hair and brown eyebrows.

Assign the 12 options in reading order. Top row from left to right: bald and clean-shaven | short and neat clean-shaven | shaggy short hair clean-shaven | loose shoulder-length hair clean-shaven. Middle row: low ponytail clean-shaven | short mass of natural curls clean-shaven | short neat hair with a short connected beard | bald with a long full beard. Bottom row: loose long hair with a long full beard | close-cropped hair with a pointed goatee | tied-back hair with a moustache only, chin clean | long straight hair with a tidy square boxed beard.  Paint each hairstyle and facial-hair choice as one anatomically coherent head with its eyes, eyebrows, skin, shape, natural rooted hair, intact ears, visible chin and short neck together. Keep the head attachment shape and neck cutoff the same across options.

Use generous transparent gutters between all heads and around the canvas. Every head entirely inside its cell, subject occupying approximately 68% of its cell height, with extra bottom padding on the final row and extra space on braided cells for strands. The viewer should see the entire scalp and silhouette, whole chin and short neck in every cell. Remove the guide lines and guide background. Output true alpha: all empty pixels fully transparent, without matte, faint silhouettes, interior rectangle backgrounds, or falloff. No ground, no shadow, no grass, nothing behind the character or object.
No glow, haze or backdrop.
